title: Gold & Silver Alert: The Rate Cut Just Exposed a Silver Problem
speaker: Summit Metals host (unnamed)

macro_themes.view: Fed minutes show unanimity on the September hike; market now prices another hike in December; a slower path could help if real yields fall.
Real yields are the key driver of metals; rising real yields precede corrections, falling real yields give metals strong support.
Bond yields rising worldwide (US, UK, Japan, Germany, France) at ~25-year highs; a headwind now but the long-run opportunity for stackers.
China reopens after a week-long holiday tonight; watch Shanghai premiums - weak demand would be a negative sign.
Central banks will buy heavily on the dip, providing a floor under gold.

calls.condition: If real yields stabilize/fall and central banks keep buying, metals take off; continued rising real yields = caution.
calls.reason: Gold down ~26% from high; Summit pressure index 49 (barely favorable) says lean gold over silver; macro reasons to own gold unchanged and central banks buy dips.
calls.quote: Our models are indicating that we should still continue to lean gold.

calls.condition: Possible initial liquidation flush first; after that, metals set to take off. Weak China premiums would be a negative.
calls.reason: Silver ~50% off its high but still in a 46 Moz 2026 supply deficit; buy small and keep powder dry until direction is clear.
calls.quote: I think it means that silver still is in a very significant and good place moving forward as we look long-term
